literal: The killer of those who joined called anger, will burn the safe raft called kin.
translation: The killer called anger destroys the very person who harbors it. It will also burn down the safe raft known as one's family and friends.
modern: சினம் என்னும் தீ தன்னைச் சேர்ந்தவர்களையே அழிப்பதோடு, சுற்றம் என்று சொல்லப்படும் பாதுகாப்பான தெப்பத்தையும் சுட்டழித்துவிடும்.
explanation: Anger is described as a destructive force that first ruins the person who holds onto it. Beyond destroying the individual, it also burns away their vital support system. The poet uses the metaphor of a safe raft to represent family and friends, showing that anger leaves a person completely isolated and defenseless in the sea of life.
